broadcast.title: Send Mass WhatsApp Broadcasts with Protected Reputation
broadcast.subtitle: Reach thousands of customers in minutes without fear of number blocking. Powered by 5-Layer Smart Delivery Protection, Dynamic Spintax, and Automatic Number Rotation.
broadcast.trustBadge: Safe for Business Numbers • 5-Layer Smart Delivery • Cost-Effective
broadcast.protectionSubtitle: Industry-leading anti-ban architecture designed to safeguard your business WhatsApp reputation.
broadcast.layer1Desc: Automatically randomizes sentence synonyms like {Hello|Hi|Good Day} making every message unique and destroying Meta spam hash detection.
broadcast.layer2Desc: Transmits ChatPresenceComposing status proportionally to message length, faithfully mimicking real human typing behavior.
broadcast.layer3Desc: Applies randomized 3–7 second intervals between message dispatches to prevent unnatural traffic bursts.
broadcast.layer4Desc: Gradual volume ramp-up for newly paired WhatsApp numbers to build healthy reputation before high-volume blasts.
broadcast.layer5Desc: Evenly distributes recipient lists across standby numbers when primary accounts reach their safe daily limit.
broadcast.playgroundSubtitle: Type your message using {opt1|opt2} syntax and click the button to see how messages randomize live in your browser.
